🎥🎬: Closer (2004)

In London, the lives of four strangers become deeply intertwined when attraction, jealousy, and betrayal pull them into a complicated web of relationships. Dan, an aspiring novelist, begins a romance with Alice, but his attraction to photographer Anna soon threatens everything they have built together.

Anna becomes involved with dermatologist Larry, yet her connection with Dan refuses to disappear. As the couples cross emotional boundaries and relationships begin to unravel, secrets are revealed and trust becomes increasingly difficult to repair.

With each character searching for love while struggling with desire and insecurity, Closer explores how honesty can sometimes hurt just as deeply as deception, leaving all four to confront the consequences of the choices they make.

source_details.synopsis: Closer is a 2004 American romantic drama film directed and produced by Mike Nichols and written by Patrick Marber, based on his award-winning 1997 play. It stars Julia Roberts, Jude Law, Natalie Portman, and Clive Owen. The film, like the play on which it is based, has been seen by some as a modern version of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Lorenzo Da Ponte's 1790 opera Così fan tutte, with references to the opera in both the plot and the soundtrack. Owen starred in the play as Dan, the role played by Law in the film. Closer received favorable reviews and grossed $115 million at the box office.
